gist.summary: Pollinations CLI 0.1.53 records the original text of a symlinked harness config and restores the symlink when an unedited OpenCode configuration is disconnected or setup fails. Absolute and relative links are preserved without changing their targets or permissions; if the user edited the detached regular config, their edits remain instead. Older snapshots without symlink metadata remain readable.
